title: Calendar
description: Show the events in a calendar file as date cards, a timeline, a table or a list.
demoHtml:
<ics-render calendar-data="BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//HAX//ics-render demo//EN
X-WR-CALNAME:Project schedule
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:kickoff@example.com
DTSTART:20261015T180000Z
DTEND:20261015T190000Z
SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Initial alignment meeting with the project team.
LOCATION:Conference Room A
END:VEVENT
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:review@example.com
DTSTART:20261029T150000Z
DTEND:20261029T160000Z
SUMMARY:Design Review
LOCATION:Zoom
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR" display-as="cards"></ics-render>

attributes.name: data-source
attributes.description: URL of the .ics file, usually one uploaded to the site's files.

attributes.name: calendar-data
attributes.description: Calendar file contents, for rendering without a fetch.

attributes.name: display-as
attributes.description: How to present the events: cards, timeline, table or list.

attributes.name: caption
attributes.description: Caption for the table and a heading for the other modes. Falls back to the calendar's own name when the file carries one.

attributes.name: debounce-delay
attributes.description: Delay in ms before a data-source change triggers a load. Exposed mainly so tests can shrink it; the default matches csv-render.

gizmo.title: Calendar
gizmo.description: Show the events in a calendar file as date cards, a timeline, a table or a list.

configure.title: Calendar file
configure.description: Upload or choose an .ics calendar file. Its events are read in the browser.

configure.title: Display as
configure.description: How to present what the file contains.

configure.title: Heading
configure.description: Shown above the events, and as the table caption. Defaults to the calendar's own name.
